  #
  # This middleware rescues any exception returned by the application and calls an
  # exceptions app that will wrap it in a format for the end user.

  # `ShowExceptions`. Every time there is an exception, `ShowExceptions` will
  # store the exception in `env["action_dispatch.exception"]`, rewrite the
  # `PATH_INFO` to the exception status code, and call the Rack app.
  #
  # In Rails applications, the exceptions app can be configured with
  # `config.exceptions_app`, which defaults to ActionDispatch::PublicExceptions.
  #
  # If the application returns a response with the `X-Cascade` header set to
  # `"pass"`, this middleware will send an empty response as a result with the
  # correct status code. If any exception happens inside the exceptions app, this
  # middleware catches the exceptions and returns a failsafe response.
  class ShowExceptions
    def initialize(app, exceptions_app)
      @app = app
      @exceptions_app = exceptions_app
    end

    def call(env)
      @app.call(env)
    rescue Exception => exception
      request = ActionDispatch::Request.new env
      backtrace_cleaner = request.get_header("action_dispatch.backtrace_cleaner")
      wrapper = ExceptionWrapper.new(backtrace_cleaner, exception)
      request.set_header "action_dispatch.exception", wrapper.unwrapped_exception
      request.set_header "action_dispatch.report_exception", !wrapper.rescue_response?

      if wrapper.show?(request)
        render_exception(request.dup, wrapper)
      else
        raise exception
      end
    end

    private
      def render_exception(request, wrapper)
        status = wrapper.status_code
        request.set_header "action_dispatch.original_path", request.path_info
        request.set_header "action_dispatch.original_request_method", request.raw_request_method
        fallback_to_html_format_if_invalid_mime_type(request)
        request.path_info = "/#{status}"
        request.request_method = "GET"
        response = @exceptions_app.call(request.env)
        response[1][Constants::X_CASCADE] == "pass" ? pass_response(status) : response
      rescue Exception => failsafe_error
        $stderr.puts "Error during failsafe response: #{failsafe_error}\n  #{failsafe_error.backtrace * "\n  "}"

        [500, { Rack::CONTENT_TYPE => "text/plain; charset=utf-8" },
          ["500 Internal Server Error\n" \
          "If you are the administrator of this website, then please read this web " \
          "application's log file and/or the web server's log file to find out what " \

steps.message:
### Root Cause

`Rails::Application#env_config` lazily memoizes `@app_env_config` on first access in a worker process, copying `config.action_dispatch.show_exceptions` into `env_config["action_dispatch.show_exceptions"]`. Every request merges `env_config` into the Rack `env`, and `ActionDispatch::ShowExceptions` / `ActionDispatch::DebugExceptions` inspect `request.get_header("action_dispatch.show_exceptions")` from that `env` rather than reading `Rails.application.config.action_dispatch.show_exceptions` directly.

Previously, `ActiveSupport::TestCase#with_raised_exceptions` in `test/test_helper.rb` only toggled `Rails.application.config.action_dispatch.show_exceptions`:

- If another request ran **first** in the same worker process, `@app_env_config` was already memoized with `"action_dispatch.show_exceptions" => :rescuable`, so `with_raised_exceptions` had no effect on requests inside its block (`BookAbsenceTest` rendered a 404 instead of raising `ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound`).
- If `BookAbsenceTest` ran **first** in a worker process, the first call to `Rails.application.env_config` happened inside `with_raised_exceptions` while `config.action_dispatch.show_exceptions` was `:none`, permanently memoizing `"action_dispatch.show_exceptions" => :none` for all subsequent tests in that worker process (causing controller tests expecting a rendered 404 page to raise `ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound`).

### Changes Made

1. **`test/test_helper.rb`**: Updated `with_raised_exceptions` to read the prior values of both `Rails.application.config.action_dispatch.show_exceptions` and `Rails.application.env_config["action_dispatch.show_exceptions"]` before mutating either (ensuring lazy initialization of `env_config` captures the pre-existing setting), set both to `:none` for the duration of the block, and restore both in `ensure`.
2. **`test/integration/with_raised_exceptions_test.rb`**: Added integration tests verifying `with_raised_exceptions` raises controller errors inside the block while rendering error pages before and after in the same process, restores error page rendering when exceptions escape the block, and handles nested `with_raised_exceptions` blocks.
